t: You are at Brandlehow Primary School, a community school in Putney, in the London Borough of Wandsworth. The building is Grade II listed. It was designed by Ernő Goldfinger, the Hungarian-British architect and furniture designer, whose career ran from the early twentieth century to 1987. A school like this is a good reminder that a celebrated modernist architect worked on everyday public buildings, not only on famous landmarks, and that this one has been recognised as worth protecting.
